title: A learner text
description: The texts of the content of an app: a text, and restricted Markdown, each a string while German is the only language of the app, else a map of texts by language. The schemas of the quiz, of the explainer and of the blocks they share refer to it.

text.description: A text for learners without formatting: a string while German is the only language of the app, else a map of texts by language ({ de: …, en: … }) with every declared language.

markdown.description: Restricted Markdown, as a text or a map of texts by language: paragraphs, **bold**, *italics*, lists, links and line breaks, formulas as $…$ in the formula command list. No headings (use a section block), no HTML, no images (use a figure block), no code (use a code block), no quotes (use a quote block), no tables (use a table block). A link to a page of the app starts with / and names it from the app's root: /<chapter>/<page>/#<section>.
